WorkspaceSnapshot.title: WorkspaceSnapshot
WorkspaceSnapshot.description: Synced coaching institute configuration, batches, staff, fee plans, notices, inquiries, reminders, and security metadata.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

syncedByEmail.description: Verified email of the Google account performing sync.

schemaVersion.description: Backup and sync payload format version.

batchCount.description: Count of active and inactive batches.

deviceLabel.description: Human-readable client label for last sync.

instituteConfig.description: Institute branding, timings, capacity, and study centres.

staffList.description: Bounded list of assigned faculty and staff members.

batches.description: Bounded list of scheduled class batches.

feePlans.description: Bounded list of class-wise fee schedules.

notices.description: Bounded list of official notice board items.

inquiries.description: Bounded list of parent admission inquiries.

securityConfig.description: Institute portal password and OTP security configuration.

securityLogs.description: Bounded list of recent security audit log entries.

feeReminderSettings.description: Automated WhatsApp and in-app fee deadline reminder settings.

feeReminders.description: Bounded list of dispatched fee reminder log items.

SyncedStudent.title: SyncedStudent
SyncedStudent.description: Individual student record synced as an isolated document to avoid 1MB document limits.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workspace owner.

record.description: Complete native map of StudentRecord including feePayments and attendanceRecords.

CloudBackupMetadata.title: CloudBackupMetadata
CloudBackupMetadata.description: Named cloud backup restore point containing workspace configuration and metadata.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the backup owner.

createdByEmail.description: Verified email of user who created backup.

instituteName.description: Institute name at time of backup.

studentCount.description: Number of student records in backup.

workspaceData.description: Native map holding instituteConfig, staffList, batches, feePlans, notices, inquiries, securityConfig, securityLogs, feeReminderSettings, and feeReminders.

CloudBackupStudent.title: CloudBackupStudent
CloudBackupStudent.description: Immutable student snapshot belonging to a parent CloudBackupMetadata document.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the backup owner.

record.description: Complete native map snapshot of the StudentRecord.

/users/{userId}/workspaces/{workspaceId}.description: Owner-isolated live synced coaching workspace document.
